text: Reference run: the Part A build, done step by step from the guide in Claude Code. This log summarises each stage; the full documents are under Documents.
Guide steps 2.1 to 2.2
extract-rules skill run on the Contract Rules PDF. 65 testable rules, 99 excluded clauses, 4 statutory thresholds left null. verify_quotes.py: ALL CHECKS PASSED (65 rules, 99 excluded, 0 warning(s)).
Guide steps 3.1 to 3.4

spend-analyst: 10,607 payments read, 8,534 kept, 7 indicator tests, self-check 8 of 8. findings-analyst: 20 audits, 10 risk themes, the council's 5x5 scoring method; 130 quotes verified; three items checked against rendered PDF pages, all matched.
Guide steps 3.5 to 3.7
risk-assessment skill written from the guide's prompt and tested on fixtures. risk-assessor rated 10 risks; build_register.py: warnings 0, failures 0; no supplier names in risk text.
Guide steps 4.1 to 4.2
Jeremy Lee, 2026-10-06: approve R-02 to R-09, amend R-01 (bring into scope), reject R-10 (covered by R-04).
Guide steps 4.3 and 5.1
Register revision 1: R-01 amended, R-10 rejected. build_pack.py --gate: gate closed, 9 risks in scope.
Guide steps 5.2 to 5.7

planner, challenger and qa-reviewer: 3 pack versions, 12 challenges in 2 rounds (11 resolved, 1 for the auditor), QA v3 READY FOR SIGN-OFF (4/4 checks). 9 risks, 11 controls, 17 tests, 229 sampled payments.

message to planner: CHALLENGE #1 [sample] R-04: The only transaction test for the one Extreme risk (T-04.2) takes the 10 largest unmatched suppliers, which are the ones most likely to hold long-term contracts awarded before the notice export starts, and it includes a council payee. Ask: stratify T-04.2 with 5 from the top and at least 5 from suppliers between £25,000 and £100,000 annualised, replace or justify the council payee, and state that T-04.2 suppliers found on the register in T-04.1 are swapped for the next supplier.

message to planner: CHALLENGE #2 [rating] R-03: Likelihood 2 rests on 2 split windows, while the off-contract top 20 shows 14 unmatched general-procurement suppliers with an annualised estimate at or above the £500,000 Key Decision threshold. Ask: this goes to the auditor as a rating point; in the pack, add the unmatched suppliers at or above £500,000 annualised to the T-03 evidence line.

message to planner: CHALLENGE #3 [sample] R-02: T-02.1 takes the 10 windows with the largest totals and misses windows whose combined total sits just over £25,000. Ask: draw 5 windows largest first and 5 from windows with a combined total between £25,000 and £50,000, excluding suppliers already sampled in T-04.2.

message to planner: CHALLENGE #4 [sample] R-09: R-09's likelihood was raised for the Limited opinion on Direct Payments, but T-09.1 may include no direct payment. Ask: add a stratum of up to 5 direct-payment items, or, if the spend data cannot identify direct payments, say so in T-09.1 and in the memo Limitations.

message to planner: CHALLENGE #5 [coverage] R-04: The memo names neither grants nor agency staff as untested populations. Ask: add a Limitations line saying grant and agency-staff spend are outside the tests, with their window totals and the reason.

message to planner: CHALLENGE #6 [coverage] R-03: CPR-49 is listed as not tested, but T-01.1, T-02.1 and T-04.2 already request the award decision. Ask: add CPR-49 to T-04.2 and T-01.1 with a step confirming who made the award, and remove it from the not-tested list.

message to planner: CHALLENGE #7 [sample] R-01: T-01.1 samples 5 of only 10 general-procurement payments in the band, one a council payee. Ask: test all 10 band payments, and mark or replace the council payee with a reason.
message to planner: CHALLENGE #8 [sample] R-06: R-06 has 7 suppliers but T-06.1 samples 5. Ask: test all 7 suppliers.

message to challenger: RESPONSE #1: accepted. T-04.2 now takes the 5 largest unmatched GP suppliers and new T-04.3 takes 5 between £25,000 and £100,000 annualised; both exclude public-body payees; a supplier found on the register in T-04.1 is replaced by the next in recipe order.
message to challenger: RESPONSE #2: for the auditor. It is a rating point, so the plan is unchanged.

message to challenger: RESPONSE #3: accepted in part. T-02.1 takes 5 windows totalling £25,000 to £50,000; new T-02.2 takes the 5 largest remaining. Declined the T-04 exclusion: exclude_drawn_in only sees earlier tests.
message to challenger: RESPONSE #4: accepted. New T-09.2 samples 5 'Direct Payment' rows (Adult Social Care only); children's direct payments cannot be identified, stated in the step and Limitations.
message to challenger: RESPONSE #5: accepted. Limitations names grant and agency-staff spend as outside the tests.
message to challenger: RESPONSE #6: accepted. CPR-49 cited in T-01.1 and T-04.2 with an award-authority step; removed from rules_not_tested.
message to challenger: RESPONSE #7: accepted. T-01.1 tests every band payment except public-body payees (9 of 10).
message to challenger: RESPONSE #8: accepted. T-06.1 tests all 7 suppliers.
